title: qemu-fix-jammy → ubuntu/jammy-devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 9c2b77b..e10c364 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+qemu (1:6.2+dfsg-2ubuntu6.7) jammy; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Disable LTO on non-amd 64 architectures to prevent QEMU
+    coroutines from failing (LP: #1921664)
+
+ -- Michal Maloszewski <michal.maloszewski@canonical.com>  Tue, 31 Jan 2023 15:58:17 +0100
+
 qemu (1:6.2+dfsg-2ubuntu6.6) jammy-security; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: DMA reentrancy issue
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 7ca193e..1678a22 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -14,6 +14,13 @@ include /usr/share/dpkg/buildflags.mk
 
 libdir = /usr/lib/${DEB_HOST_MULTIARCH}
 
+# Disable LTO on non-amd64 builds, see:
+# https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/qemu/+bug/1921664
+# https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1952483
+ifneq ($(DEB_HOST_ARCH),amd64)
+  export DEB_BUILD_MAINT_OPTIONS += optimize=-lto
+endif
+
 ifeq ($(shell dpkg-vendor --derives-from Ubuntu && echo yes),yes)
 VENDOR := UBUNTU
 DEB_BUILD_PARALLEL = yes
